# Ordinance No. 05, Series of 2007

**Territorial Protection Task Force Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes and organizes a Territorial Protection Task Force in the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] to protect and preserve the territorial domain of the municipality. It defines the Task Force's powers, duties, responsibilities, composition, and functional committees. The ordinance also covers funding, separability, repealing clause, and effectivity.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Title: This ordinance shall be known and cited as the ordinance creating and organizing the Territorial Protection Task Force of the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]], referred to as the "TASK FORCE".

2.  **Section 2.** Purpose: The Task Force shall be the main body which shall be tasked in handling the protection and preservation of the territorial domain of the municipality.

3.  **Section 3.** Composition: The Task Force shall be organized as follows:
    - Hon. [[John Paul H. Bunag]] - Chairperson, Committee on Ordinance and Legal Matters, Chairperson
    - Hon. [[Eugenio L. Escosia]] - Vice-Chairperson, Committee on Ordinance and Legal Matters, Vice-Chairperson
    - Hon. [[Maria Glynda Hutamares-Lao]], M.D. - Member, Committee on Ordinance and Legal Matters, Member
    - Hon. [[Antonio G. Sampayo]] - Member, Committee on Ordinance and Legal Matters, Member
    - Ms. [[Noemi M. Pelaez]] - Sanggunian Bayan Secretary, Secretary
    - [[Diana I. Parcarey]] - Municipal Local Government Operations Officer, Member
    - [[Cezar Aureada]] - Municipal Assessor, Member
    - [[Wilfrido D. Alido]] - Chairman, Barangay Osmeña, Member
    - [[Efen M. Magtibay]] - Chairman, Barangay Pacatin Ilaya, Member
    - [[Romeo S. Gliane]] - Chairman, Barangay Quezon, Member
    - Chairman, Barangay Kisala, Member
    - Chairman, Barangay San Roque, Member
    - Chairman, Barangay Sisirin, Member
    - [[Hernando L. Correa]] - Individual, Counsel
    - [[Eclides G. Forbes]] - Individual, Counsel
    - [[Alwyn Brian C. Villaflor]] - Individual, Counsel
    - [[Amelthon F. Sampayo]] - Individual, Counsel

4.  **Section 4.** The Task Force shall have the following powers, duties and responsibilities:
    - Conduct inquiries, studies, researches and investigations of all internal and external territorial claim cases and other related concerns in the municipality.
    - Report to the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] the results of all inquiries, studies, researches and investigations and recommend appropriate actions.
    - Upon the authorization of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]], represent the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] in official hearings, meetings and similar appearances.
    - Initiate meetings, conferences and similar actions necessary for the fulfillment of its purpose.
    - The SB Committee on Ordinance and Legal Matters may summon local public officials, officers, local government employees, persons and such other entities under its jurisdiction and require the submission of documents and other information necessary for the fulfillment of its purpose.
    - Initiate studies and information campaigns regarding the territorial concerns and other relevant matters.
    - Recommend to the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] the appointment of additional counsels and ex-officio members.
    - Fulfill other tasks related to its purpose.

5.  **Section 5.** Functional Committees: The Task Force may form functional committees in the performance of their functions.

6.  **Section 6.** Secretariat: The Secretariat of the Task Force shall be headed by the Sanggunian Bayan Secretariat and the Municipal Local Government Operations Officer and their assigned staff. The Secretariat shall be responsible for the documentation of proceedings, preparation of reports and such other assistance as may be required in the discharged of its functions.

7.  **Section 7.** Term of Office: The members of the task force shall serve for a period of one (1) year from the date of appointment or until such time that the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] has terminated the appointment.

8.  **Section 8.** Funding: Expenses incurred by the Task Force in the fulfillment of its function shall be chargeable against any local funds appropriated for this purpose.

9.  **Section 9.** Separability Clause: If, for any reason, part of this ordinance be held unlawful, invalid or unconstitutional as determined by competent authorities, the remaining parts hereof unaffected shall continue to be valid and enforceable.

10. **Section 10.** Repealing Clause: All laws, rules, regulations or ordinances or portion thereof which are inconsistent with any provision of this ordinance are hereby revoked, amended and/or modified accordingly.

11. **Section 11.** Effectivity: This ordinance shall take effect immediately after all the requirements of [[RA-7160|Republic Act 7160]] otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991 and its implementing rules and regulations.
